042/**
043 * Session object that lives for the duration of a single use of {@link XmlSerializer}.
044 *
045 * <h2 class='section'>Notes:</h2><ul>
046 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
050 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/XmlSupport">XML</a>
051
052 * </ul>
053 */
054@SuppressWarnings({
055   "java:S110", // Deep inheritance inherent to the serializer/parser session hierarchy
056   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
057   "java:S1452", // create() and getXmlWriter() return wildcard Builder<?>/XmlWriter<?> because the concrete self-type is not known statically
058   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for this specific logic
059   "java:S6541", // Single-threaded session contexts do not require synchronization
060   "null", // Null handling verified by context or framework
061   "rawtypes", // Raw Map/Collection necessary for serializer dispatch over heterogeneous types
062   "resource", // Writer/Closeable resources managed by try-with-resources; analyzer FP in lambdas
063   "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked casts in serializer dispatch
064})
065public class XmlSerializerSession extends WriterSerializerSession implements RecordWritable {

244   /**

249   protected XmlSerializerSession(Builder<?> builder) {
250      super(builder);
251      ctx = builder.ctx;
252      addNamespaceUrisToRoot = builder.addNamespaceUrisToRoot;
253      autoDetectNamespaces = builder.autoDetectNamespaces;
254      enableNamespaces = builder.enableNamespaces;
255      textNodeDelimiter = builder.textNodeDelimiter;
256      // namespaces must be populated BEFORE findDefaultNamespace() runs below -- it resolves a name-only
257      // or URI-only default namespace by searching getNamespaces(), which otherwise still sees the
258      // field initializer's empty list here, so both search loops always iterate zero times and the
259      // namespace is returned unresolved (missing whichever of name/uri wasn't supplied).
260      namespaces = new ArrayList<>(ctx.getNamespaces());
261      defaultNamespace = findDefaultNamespace(
262         builder.defaultNamespace != null ? Namespace.create(builder.defaultNamespace) : ctx.getDefaultNamespace()
263      );
264   }

312   /**
313    * Add a namespace to this session.
314    *
315    * @param ns The namespace being added.
316    */
317   private void addNamespace(Namespace ns) {
318      if (ns == defaultNamespace)
319         return;
320
321      for (var n : namespaces)
322         if (n == ns)
323            return;
324
325      if (nn(defaultNamespace) && (eq(ns.uri, defaultNamespace.uri) || eq(ns.name, defaultNamespace.name)))
326         defaultNamespace = ns;
327      else
328         namespaces = addAll(namespaces, ns);
329   }
330
331   private Namespace findDefaultNamespace(Namespace n) {
332      if (n == null)
333         return null;
334      if (nn(n.name) && nn(n.uri))
335         return n;
336      if (n.uri == null) {
337         for (var n2 : getNamespaces())
338            if (eq(n2.name, n.name))
339               return n2;
340      }
341      if (n.name == null) {
342         for (var n2 : getNamespaces())
343            if (eq(n2.uri, n.uri))
344               return n2;
345      }
346      return n;
347   }

349   /**
350    * Checks if an object is a text node (String or primitive type).
351    */
352   private static boolean isTextNode(Object o) {
353      if (o == null)
354         return false;
355      var c = o.getClass();
356      // Text nodes are strings and primitives (not beans, collections, arrays, or other complex types)
357      return CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(c) || Number.class.isAssignableFrom(c) || Boolean.class.isAssignableFrom(c) || c.isPrimitive();
358   }

360   private boolean isXmlText(XmlFormat format, ClassMeta<?> sType) {
361      if (format == XMLTEXT)
362         return true;
363      var xcm = getXmlClassMeta(sType);
364      if (xcm == null)
365         return false;
366      return xcm.getFormat() == XMLTEXT;
367   }

369   private boolean isRawText(XmlFormat format, ClassMeta<?> sType) {
370      if (format == RAWTEXT)
371         return true;

373      if (xcm == null)
374         return false;
375      return xcm.getFormat() == RAWTEXT;

378   private Optional<Map.Entry<String,Object>> getPropertyKeyValueIfNotIgnored(BeanPropertyValue p, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) {
379      var key = p.getName();
380      var value = p.getValue();
381      if (nn(p.getThrown()))
382         onBeanGetterException(pMeta, p.getThrown());
383      if (canIgnoreValue(pMeta, key, value))
384         return oe();

388   private ContentResult writeBeanMap(XmlWriter<?> out, BeanMap<?> m, Namespace elementNs, boolean isCollapsed, boolean isMixedOrText) throws SerializeException {
389      boolean hasChildren = false;
390      var bm = m.getMeta();
391
392      var lp = new ArrayList<BeanPropertyValue>();
393
394      var checkNull = (Predicate<Object>)(x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x));
395      m.forEachValue(checkNull, (pMeta, key, value, thrown) -> lp.add(new BeanPropertyValue(pMeta, key, value, thrown)));
396
397      var xbm = getXmlBeanMeta(bm);
398
399      // @formatter:off
400      Set<String> attrs = xbm.getAttrPropertyNames();
401      Set<String> elements = xbm.getElementPropertyNames();
402      Set<String> collapsedElements = xbm.getCollapsedPropertyNames();
403      var attrsProperty = xbm.getAttrsPropertyName();
404      var contentProperty = xbm.getContentPropertyName();
405      // @formatter:on
406
407      XmlFormat cf = null;
408
409      Object content = null;
410      ClassMeta<?> contentType = null;
411      for (var p : lp) {
412         var n = p.getName();
413         if (attrs.contains(n) || attrs.contains("*") || eq(n, attrsProperty)) {
414            var pMeta = p.getMeta();
415            if (pMeta.canRead()) {
416               var kv = getPropertyKeyValueIfNotIgnored(p, pMeta);
417               if (kv.isEmpty())
418                  continue;
419               var key = kv.get().getKey();
420               var value = kv.get().getValue();
421               var bpXml = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(pMeta);
422               var ns = (isEnableNamespaces() && bpXml.getNamespace() != elementNs ? bpXml.getNamespace() : null);
423
424               if (pMeta.isUri()) {
425                  if (isAllowedAttribute(key, value))
426                     out.attrUri(ns, key, value);
427               } else if (eq(n, attrsProperty)) {
428                  if (value instanceof BeanMap<?> value2) {
429                     value2.forEachValue(x -> true, (pMeta2, key2, value3, thrown2) -> {
430                        if (nn(thrown2))
431                           onBeanGetterException(pMeta, thrown2);
432                        if (isAllowedAttribute(key2, value3))
433                           out.attr(ns, key2, value3);
434                     });
435                  } else /* Map */ {
436                     var m2 = (Map)value;
437                     if (nn(m2))
438                        m2.forEach((k, v) -> {
439                           if (isAllowedAttribute(s(k), v))
440                              out.attr(ns, s(k), v);
441                        });
442                  }
443               } else if (isAllowedAttribute(key, value)) {
444                  out.attr(ns, key, value);
445               }
446            }
447         }
448      }
449
450      boolean hasContent = false;
451      boolean preserveWhitespace = false;
452      boolean isVoidElement = xbm.getContentFormat() == VOID;
453
454      for (var p : lp) {
455         BeanPropertyMeta pMeta = p.getMeta();
456         if (pMeta.canRead()) {
457            ClassMeta<?> cMeta = (ClassMeta<?>) p.getBeanInfo();
458
459            var n = p.getName();
460            if (eq(n, contentProperty)) {
461               content = p.getValue();
462               contentType = (ClassMeta<?>) p.getBeanInfo();
463               hasContent = true;
464               cf = xbm.getContentFormat();
465               if (cf.isOneOf(MIXED, MIXED_PWS, TEXT, TEXT_PWS, XMLTEXT, RAWTEXT))
466                  isMixedOrText = true;
467               if (cf.isOneOf(MIXED_PWS, TEXT_PWS))
468                  preserveWhitespace = true;
469               if ((contentType.isCollection() && ((Collection)content).isEmpty()) || (contentType.isArray() && Array.getLength(content) == 0))
470                  hasContent = false;
471            } else if (elements.contains(n) || collapsedElements.contains(n) || elements.contains("*") || collapsedElements.contains("*")) {
472               var kv = getPropertyKeyValueIfNotIgnored(p, pMeta);
473               if (kv.isEmpty())
474                  continue;
475               var key = kv.get().getKey();
476               var value = kv.get().getValue();
477               if (! hasChildren) {
478                  hasChildren = true;
479                  out.appendIf(! isCollapsed, '>').nlIf(! isMixedOrText, indent);
480               }
481
482               var bpXml = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(pMeta);
483               writeAnything(out, value, cMeta, key, null, bpXml.getNamespace(), false, bpXml.getXmlFormat(), isMixedOrText, false, pMeta);
484            }
485         }
486      }
487      if (contentProperty == null && ! hasContent) {
488         if (hasChildren) {
489            return CR_ELEMENTS;
490         } else if (isVoidElement) {
491            return CR_VOID;
492         } else {
493            return CR_EMPTY;
494         }
495      }
496
497      // Serialize XML content.
498      if (nn(content)) {
499         out.w('>').nlIf(! isMixedOrText, indent);
500         if (contentType == null) {
501            // No content type specified - skip content serialization
502         } else if (contentType.isCollection()) {
503            var c = (Collection)content;
504            boolean previousWasTextNode = false;
505            for (var value : c) {
506               boolean currentIsTextNode = isTextNode(value);
507               // Insert delimiter between consecutive text nodes
508               if (previousWasTextNode && currentIsTextNode && nn(textNodeDelimiter) && ! textNodeDelimiter.isEmpty()) {
509                  out.append(textNodeDelimiter);
510               }
511               writeAnything(out, value, contentType.getElementType(), null, null, null, false, cf, isMixedOrText, preserveWhitespace, null);
512               previousWasTextNode = currentIsTextNode;
513            }
514         } else if (contentType.isArray()) {
515            var c = toList(Object[].class, content);
516            boolean previousWasTextNode = false;
517            for (var value : c) {
518               boolean currentIsTextNode = isTextNode(value);
519               // Insert delimiter between consecutive text nodes
520               if (previousWasTextNode && currentIsTextNode && nn(textNodeDelimiter) && ! textNodeDelimiter.isEmpty()) {
521                  out.append(textNodeDelimiter);
522               }
523               writeAnything(out, value, contentType.getElementType(), null, null, null, false, cf, isMixedOrText, preserveWhitespace, null);
524               previousWasTextNode = currentIsTextNode;
525            }
526         } else {
527            writeAnything(out, content, contentType, null, null, null, false, cf, isMixedOrText, preserveWhitespace, null);
528         }
529      } else {
530         // A null FREEFORM content property represents an empty container element (e.g. an empty HTML <table> or
531         // <thead>), which must render as an empty element rather than an explicit null.  Emitting nil='true' here
532         // is surprising for such containers.  Other content formats (TEXT/TEXT_PWS/XMLTEXT for null-vs-empty-string
533         // round-tripping, and MIXED/MIXED_PWS) retain the nil marker to preserve existing behavior.
534         if (isAddJsonTags() && xbm.getContentFormat() != FREEFORM)
535            out.attr("nil", "true");
536         out.w('>').nlIf(! isMixedOrText, indent);
537      }
538      return isMixedOrText ? CR_MIXED : CR_ELEMENTS;
539   }

541   private XmlWriter<?> writeCollection(XmlWriter<?> out, Object in, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> eType, BeanPropertyMeta ppMeta, boolean isMixed) throws SerializeException {
542
543      var eeType = eType.getElementType();
544
545      var c = (sType.isCollection() ? (Collection)in : toList(sType.inner(), in));
546
547      String type2 = null;
548
549      var eName = Holder.of(type2);
550      var eNs = Holder.<Namespace>empty();
551
552      if (nn(ppMeta)) {
553         XmlBeanPropertyMeta bpXml = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(ppMeta);
554         eName.set(bpXml.getChildName());
555         eNs.set(bpXml.getNamespace());
556      }
557
558      // Track if previous element was a text node for delimiter insertion
559      var previousWasTextNode = Holder.of(false);
560
561      forEachEntry(c, x -> {
562         var currentIsTextNode = isTextNode(x);
563
564         // Insert delimiter between consecutive text nodes
565         if (isTrue(previousWasTextNode.get()) && currentIsTextNode && nn(textNodeDelimiter) && ! textNodeDelimiter.isEmpty()) {
566            out.append(textNodeDelimiter);
567         }
568
569         writeAnything(out, x, eeType, null, eName.get(), eNs.get(), false, XmlFormat.DEFAULT, isMixed, false, null);
570         previousWasTextNode.set(currentIsTextNode);
571      });
572
573      return out;
574   }

576   private XmlWriter<?> writeStreamable(XmlWriter<?> out, Object in, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> eType, BeanPropertyMeta ppMeta, boolean isMixed) throws SerializeException {
577
578      var eeType = eType.getElementType();
579
580      var eName = Holder.<String>empty();
581      var eNs = Holder.<Namespace>empty();
582
583      if (nn(ppMeta)) {
584         XmlBeanPropertyMeta bpXml = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(ppMeta);
585         eName.set(bpXml.getChildName());
586         eNs.set(bpXml.getNamespace());
587      }
588
589      var previousWasTextNode = Holder.of(false);
590
591      forEachStreamableEntry(in, sType, x -> {
592         var currentIsTextNode = isTextNode(x);
593
594         if (isTrue(previousWasTextNode.get()) && currentIsTextNode && nn(textNodeDelimiter) && ! textNodeDelimiter.isEmpty()) {
595            out.append(textNodeDelimiter);
596         }
597
598         writeAnything(out, x, eeType, null, eName.get(), eNs.get(), false, XmlFormat.DEFAULT, isMixed, false, null);
599         previousWasTextNode.set(currentIsTextNode);
600      });
601
602      return out;
603   }

605   private ContentResult writeMap(XmlWriter<?> out, Map m, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> eKeyType, ClassMeta<?> eValueType, boolean isMixed) throws SerializeException {
606
607      var keyType = eKeyType == null ? sType.getKeyType() : eKeyType;
608      var valueType = eValueType == null ? sType.getValueType() : eValueType;
609
610      var hasChildren = Flag.create();
611      forEachEntry(m, e -> {
612
613         var k = e.getKey();
614         if (k == null) {
615            k = "\u0000";
616         } else {
617            k = generalize(k, keyType);
618            if (isTrimStrings() && k instanceof String)
619               k = k.toString().trim();
620         }
621
622         var value = e.getValue();
623
624         hasChildren.ifNotSet(() -> out.w('>').nlIf(! isMixed, indent)).set();
625         writeAnything(out, value, valueType, toString(k), null, null, false, XmlFormat.DEFAULT, isMixed, false, null);
626      });
627
628      return hasChildren.isSet() ? CR_ELEMENTS : CR_EMPTY;
629   }

638   /**
639    * Opens a whole-value push generator targeting XML output, bound to this live session.

642    * Because XML's wire format (attributes, namespaces, mixed content) is non-trivial to expose
643    * as a fine-grained token writer, this implementation supports only the cursor-level POJO
644    * bridge &mdash; {@link RecordWriter#write(Object) write(Object)} delegates to
645    * {@link SerializerSession#write(Object, Object)}.
646    *
647    * @param output The output.
648    * @return A new {@link RecordWriter}.
649    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying output.

664   /**
665    * Recursively searches for the XML namespaces on the specified POJO and adds them to the serializer context object.
666    *
667    * @param o The POJO to check.
668    * @throws SerializeException Thrown if bean recursion occurred.
669    */
670   protected final void findNsfMappings(Object o) throws SerializeException {
671      ClassMeta<?> aType = null;                // The actual type
672
673      try {
674         aType = push(null, o, null);
675      } catch (MarshallingRecursionException e) {
676         throw new SerializeException(e);
677      }
678
679      if (nn(aType)) {
680         var ns = getXmlClassMeta(aType).getNamespace();
681         if (nn(ns) && nn(ns.uri))
682            addNamespace(ns);
683      }
684
685      // Handle recursion
686      if (nn(aType) && ! aType.isPrimitive()) {
687
688         BeanMap<?> bm = null;
689         if (aType.isBeanMap()) {
690            bm = (BeanMap<?>)o;
691         } else if (aType.isBean()) {
692            bm = toBeanMap(o);
693         } else if (aType.isDelegate()) {
694            var innerType = (ClassMeta<?>)((Delegate<?>)o).getBeanInfo();
695            var ns = Holder.of(getXmlClassMeta(innerType).getNamespace());
696            if (ns.isPresent()) {
697               if (nn(ns.get().uri))
698                  addNamespace(ns.get());
699               else
700                  ns.getAndUnset();
701            }
702
703            if (innerType.isBean()) {
704               innerType.getBeanMeta().getProperties().values().stream().filter(BeanPropertyMeta::canRead).forEach(x -> {
705                  ns.set(getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(x).getNamespace());
706                  if (ns.isPresent() && nn(ns.get().uri))
707                     addNamespace(ns.get());
708               });
709            } else if (innerType.isMap()) {
710               ((Map<?,?>)o).forEach((k, v) -> findNsfMappings(v));
711            } else if (innerType.isCollection()) {
712               ((Collection<?>)o).forEach(this::findNsfMappings);
713            }
714
715         } else if (aType.isMap()) {
716            ((Map<?,?>)o).forEach((k, v) -> findNsfMappings(v));
717         } else if (aType.isCollection()) {
718            ((Collection<?>)o).forEach(this::findNsfMappings);
719         } else if (aType.isArray() && ! aType.getElementType().isPrimitive()) {
720            for (var o2 : ((Object[])o))
721               findNsfMappings(o2);
722         }
723         if (nn(bm)) {
724            var checkNull = (Predicate<Object>)(x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x));
725            bm.forEachValue(checkNull, (pMeta, key, value, thrown) -> {
726               var ns = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(pMeta).getNamespace();
727               if (nn(ns) && nn(ns.uri))
728                  addNamespace(ns);
729
730               try {
731                  findNsfMappings(value);
732               } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception x) {
733                  // Ignore
734               }
735            });
736         }
737      }
738
739      pop();
740   }
